## sminer ingest

Read new transcript lines into the database

### Synopsis

Read new transcript lines into the database.

Ingest is incremental: each transcript is re-read only from where the last run
stopped, so repeat runs are cheap. Text is redacted before it is stored, and
raw transcripts are never copied.

```
sminer ingest [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  sminer ingest
  sminer ingest --since 30d --root ~/.claude/projects --root /mnt/old/projects
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help           help for ingest
      --root strings   transcript directory, repeatable (default ~/.claude/projects)
      --since string   only read transcripts modified within this window (default "90d")
```
